settings.text: Real, potent ingredients — not diluted formulas dressed up in an Ayurvedic label. Hair oil concentrates built to mix into the routine you already trust.

settings.quote: Most hair oils put just enough of a “hero” ingredient on the label to tell a good story. We put in enough to actually change the ending.

settings.label: Hair Fall
settings.heading: The
settings.text: Bhringraj literally translates to “ruler of hair” in Sanskrit — used in Ayurvedic texts for thousands of years. Most commercial versions use a trace amount, diluted into filler oil. Ours is properly heat-infused, so it’s concentrated enough to actually reduce fall and support new growth.

settings.label: Dandruff & Scalp
settings.heading: Balance,
settings.text: Jojoba closely mimics your scalp’s own natural sebum, which means it absorbs instead of sitting heavy. Ideal for an oily scalp, dandruff-prone hair, or anyone who finds traditional oils too greasy to use daily.

settings.label: Growth & Density
settings.heading: Density,
settings.text: Rich in zinc and essential fatty acids, pumpkin seed is one of the few natural ingredients with real modern research behind it — linked to reduced thinning and improved density, not just tradition.

settings.label: Dryness & Shine
settings.heading: Softness &
settings.text: Rich in Vitamin E, sweet almond softens hair, adds natural shine, and strengthens strands against breakage — a gentle, everyday formulation for dry or dull hair.

settings.quote: “Nothing on the shelf actually worked — so she made her own.”
settings.heading: It started with a mother,
settings.text:
Kehsora began the way real Ayurvedic hair care always has — at home. A mother formulating her own oil from scratch, using real, purposeful ingredients, because nothing on the shelf actually worked.

That’s still the standard today. We talked to real people before building further — mall interviews that told us the problem was never the ingredients, it was the format. Some people love the ritual of oiling. Others simply don’t have the time. So we built for both: potent concentrates that mix into what you already use, and serums for the days there’s no time to spare.
